pr_title: Fix file extension being lost when renaming, fixes for search
pr_body:
**Resolved / Related Issues**
Items resolved / related issues by this PR.
- Closes #7012
- May fix #5823

**Details of Changes**
Add details of changes here.
- Fixes an issue where file extension is lost when renaming a shortcut to a folder
- Adds an ItemNameRaw property to ListedItem, moves the logic to get the "Display" name from the raw name into ListedItem and subclasses.
- Fixes an issue where file extensions where shown in Search result page regardless of the "show file extensions" setting
- Fixes an issue where search results were loaded twice when submitting search
- Fixes an issue where a file with a random name shows when search yields no results

**Validation**
How did you test these changes?
- [x] Built and ran the app
- [x] Tested renaming files and shortcuts changing the "show file extensions" setting

issue_context.title: Renaming issue on search results
issue_context.body:
### Description

When searching something then trying to rename it, it will say the extensions has been changed (even though it doesn't show in name or renaming) and when clicking ok it wont rename it.

### Steps To Reproduce

_No response_

### Expected behavior

It should show the extension, not bring up the warning unless renaming the extension, rename the file.

### Files Version

1.9.23.0

### Windows Version

10.0.19043.1151

### Relevant Assets

_No response_
comments:
> even though it doesn't show in name or renaming

Do you mean that you don't see file extensions in the search results?

> when clicking ok it wont rename it

Could you confirm if it really does not rename it? In my testing you don't see the name change in the search page but if you go back and look for the file the name has changed.

The extension doesn't show up in the name/renaming part. but it does under for file type.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26977075/129443802-1b8feb6a-2eca-4d5d-a989-0a4bfa22895c.png)

And it does rename but also remove the file extension when doing it.
Do you have the "Show file extensions for known types" enabled? ~Is there any difference if you toggle it?~ Do the extensions show in Details view?
This also happens for shortcuts too. They don't show the .ink file extension and renaming them makes then unusable.
I can't reproduce this in search results. With shortcuts, there isn't a .lnk shown even though show file extensions is enabled, however renaming still works as expected.

~I haven't tested it with the improvements of search that might have fix that.~ Nope search renaming still asks if I want to change the extension and removes it if I click yes. But for shortcuts when I rename it, it becomes a blank file that when clicked on just bring up the open with application.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26977075/129986232-fcebca68-62ab-4f6e-95cc-303a16da470c.png)
This issue should be resolved with #7015.
